on LinkedIn Executive Education Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is an academic prowess platform which prospects, prepares, and prospers every aspirant who is looking forward to seek professional education in various digital and managerial sectors. The Executive Education Programmes at IIM Lucknow campus are extensively arrayed to offer a high-class technological, professional and inclusive experience to all the working executives that, come from various nuances of different organisations. Incorporating technological advancements like e-learning, e-books and real-time navigation is the new mandate in executive education nowadays. The diverse programme design and consistent practice to refurbish the teaching style every academic year at IIM Lucknow, makes it unique and demanding amongst all the new age and traditional company setups. Every executive education programme offered by IIM Lucknow is crafted in a manner that addresses the needs of schedule, strategy and implementation process of every organisation. Programmes are aligned to required skills and competency frameworks envisioned by learners. To conquer the ongoing business challenges, IIM Lucknow provides the novelty of programmes that are planned and provided accordingly every year. The Executive Education platform is intended to widen the outlook and reinforce the managerial, professional and technological skills of working professionals all over the world. The global visualisation of IIM Lucknow is to impart world-class executive education to all the working professionals in different domains and provide them a tactical tool to uplift their professional personas. Customized Programmes IIM Lucknow offers customized Executive Education programmes for corporate and government officials, that helps to elevate skills and overcome the day to day challenges of digital world. The Customized Programmes are tailored for group of working executives drawn from a single organisation or a consortium. Lasting impact and ingrained work culture are the imperative as well as desired necessity of every organisation, and to full fill the same, IIM Lucknow curates and delivers a number of customised programmes, that are eventually crafted by estimating the organisational needs, that cover every aspect of a company. Shaping impactful strategies into viable growth is the mission of IIM Lucknow, when it comes to offering a customized executive education programme. Developing a comprehensive customised programme requires the expertise of the faculties and proficient programme directors who take part in the designing process of a programme. The aim is to set up a compatibility between the programme designed and the organisational prerequisites, that are required to be fulfilled. This is further augmented by the inclusion of Subject Matter expert

072: The basic objective of this course in economics is to familiarise the students with the fundamental economic principles, and to examine the ways by which these principles could profitably be employed in the context of managerial decision-making. This course deals with micro-economic issues and principles involving households and firms, mainly in the areas of Demand and Supply; Production and Cost of Firms; Price/Output Decisions by firms under varying market conditions; and factor pricing.
074: This is a course in macro-economics, with a focus on the economy as a whole in aggregative terms rather than on the micro units. The concepts of supply and demand and the equilibrium that may be established between them will, however, continue to be the underlying mechanism in analysing the economy. Starting with the National Accounts, the topics to be covered include: National Income Determination and Multiplier Analysis; Business Cycles; Inflation; Monetary and Fiscal Policies to guide the Economy etc. Attention will also be given to some of the more recent advances in areas like supply side economics and rational expectations.
077: This skills based course introduces the student to the range of communication methods and forms in a dynamic business environment and provides the student with the opportunity to develop sound business communication skills. Topics and activities include Communication Foundations; Non-verbal Communication; Art of Listening; Effective Oral Presentations; Successful Employment Strategies -Writing and editing major types of Persuasive Prose in professional settings.
079: This course enhances understanding and appreciation of critical issues in managerial communication and helps student master skills needed to achieve potential as executives through Role Plays, Situational Analysis, and Creative Exercises. Strategic approaches, which can be applied to a variety of business situations, are further honed in this course. The course ensures that the students are exposed to effective Business Message Writing; Report/Proposal Writing; Employment Communication; and Cross-cultural Communication. Student will, in this course, target a specific issue of Communication in a client business environment and prepare an analytical report.
082: The package of courses under Quantitative Analysis for Management is designed to impart understanding of basic concepts, techniques and methodologies for analytical decision-making across the spectrum of managerial tasks and functions. Topics covered in this first course are: Collection, Presentation and Summarisation of Data; Probability Concepts; Basic Distributions; Correlation and Regression; Linear Programming; Transportation and assignment problems; Goal Programming.
084: Topics covered in this course are: Methods of Sampling; Index Number and Time Series Analysis; Tests of Hypothesis (concerning one and two populations); Points and Interval Estimation; Analysis of Variance; Measures of Association; Goodness of Fit Test; Non-parametric Tests.
086: Topics covered in this course are: Queuing Models and their applications; Integer Programming; Decision Analysis; Simulation.
088: The course on Advanced Data Analysis is offered with an objective that students can plan and analyse data to answer research problems. The main emphasis is on design of experiments, multiple regression analysis, multivariate data analysis and dimension reduction techniques. Use of standard softwares for the above analyses will also be demonstrated.
091: The course is designed to provide an understanding of the role and relevance of accounting function in an organisation and also the basic concepts, techniques and methodologies relevant to accounting function. Course coverage includes: Revenue recognition, Accounting for tangible and intangible assets depreciation accounting, taxation. Understanding and Analysis of Published Annual Reports; Ratio Analysis.
093: The course is designed to provide an understanding of the basic elements, concepts and system of cost accounting and the use of costing information in managerial decision-making. Major topics covered are: Basic Cost Concepts; Material, Labour and Overhead Costs; Process Costing; Costing Systems; Behaviour of Costs; Marginal Costing; Standard Costing; Variance Analysis; Costing and Budgetary Control; Costing for Managerial Decisions.
095: This course is designed to enable the students to make optimal use of the financial resources of the organisation. Major topics covered in the course are: Funds Flow Analysis; Basic Concepts of Working Capital Management; Forecasting Working Capital Needs; Cash Management.
097: The course is designed to provide an understanding of the financial policies and issues of an organisation. The major emphasis of the course will be on financing, investment and distribution decisions. 099: Behavior in Organizations: The course is designed to develop an understanding of behaviour of an individual in organisational setting.

Topics covered include: Organisational Structure, Configuration and Design; Staff-Line Role; Control Mechanisms; Power and Politics; Responsiveness; Culture; Organisational Evolution; Comparative Organisational Designs; and Organisational Change and Development.
108: The course is designed to enable the students to appreciate the role of information systems in managerial decision making; familiarise them with information systems design methodologies; to understand the hardware and software tools and technologies available for implementation of effective organisational information systems; and to appreciate the critical role of user managers in design of effective information systems.

In India too, a large number of Micro-finance Institutions (MFIs) are operating to provide financial services to rural poor. Moreover, a large number of MFIs are still dependent on concessional funding for carrying out their operations, thus putting their sustainability at stake. 000: Launched in 2000-01, the Doctoral Program in Management (DPM) is a doctoral level program of the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow. The program offers a unique opportunity to those who wish to hone their research talents and develop teaching skills.
001: The program is designed to produce high-quality academicians, researchers, and management thinkers by providing an opportunity for interdisciplinary education and research in management. The high academically charged environment of the institute helps scholar to develop and sharpen their intellect. The unique pedagogy and program structure of the DPM curriculum provide an enriching environment for personal and professional growth.
002: The doctoral program aims to admit individuals with an exceptional academic background, high motivation, discipline, and potential to become excellent researchers at international level. Research scholars are expected to join from diverse disciplines ranging from social sciences and humanities to physical sciences and engineering.
003: Through the rigorous academic program, the scholar becomes part of one of the nine research areas through the acquisition of basic theoretical knowledge and practical aspects of the area. Such activity allows close interaction with faculty members, who provide the intellectual stimulation and help develop the scholar's research interests and professional goals.

106: During first year of the programme the scholars acquire knowledge of the discipline and functional areas of management and general management. The DPM scholars, irrespective of their area of specialization, take a compulsory set of courses in the first year. At the end of the first year, the scholars undergo a summer placement/summer research assignment under the advice/guidance of their Academic Advisor.
107: The DPM scholars who already hold a one/two/three year full-time classroom based PGDM from any of the IIMs/WMP of IIM Lucknow with a minimum CGPA of 6 on a 10 point scale or an equivalent 3.0 in 4.0 point scale and corresponding letter grade `B' would be exempted from the first year course work including the summer work and would be admitted directly to II year (herby called 'exempt scholars').
108: However, sentient area may recommend additional first year courses for DPM candidates in the exempted category if area members feel that the candidate(s) requires additional inputs in a core discipline.
109: During second year of the programme the scholars acquire in-depth knowledge of the area of specialization and related fields. In addition, scholars take the DPM compulsory courses, which are specially designed to provide teaching and research skills, and to develop integrated learning. During the second year of the programme, the scholars have to choose a dissertation topic to work on which may subsequently lead them to formulate their thesis proposal.

115: On completion of the second year course work which includes dissertation work, the scholars take the comprehensive examination. 000: IIM Lucknow offers International Programme in Management for Executives or IPMX (One-year MBA) at its NOIDA Campus. This is a one-year residential programme designed for mid/ senior level professionals to prepare them for top positions in industry roles. Established in 2008, the programme holds the prestigious Triple Crown accreditation from AACSB, EQUIS, and AMBA, placing it among the top business programmes globally. A valid GMAT/GRE score is a prerequisite for applying to this programme.
001: IPMX provides the students with all aspects of business education in Indian as well as the international business environment. It accelerates understanding of business at functional and strategic levels and prepares students to manage enterprises engaged in global business. The curriculum focuses on a strategic understanding of business and is rooted in practical skill development through projects and industry interface.
002: IPMX is a rigorous program which provides ample opportunity for personal development and professional growth through an interactive learning environment. NOIDA being the hub of commercial and industrial activity, the locational advantage also plays an important role in the learning process. Industry-related assignments and real management contexts form an integral part of the course curriculum.
003: Objectives of the Programme:
004: To develop an understanding of knowledge and skills in key functional areas
005: To equip executives to become thought leaders in global context.
006: To integrate and apply business knowledge, re-skill and refresh managers and enable further growth
007: To develop a global perspective
008: To equip participants with analytical and interpersonal skills and develop their leadership capabilities
009: To enable participants to be change agents in businesses across borders and cultures
010: Note: IIML is working with other IIMs to engage with and to address the concerns of the MHRD related to the program. The final status of the program (Degree / Diploma) would depend upon the outcome of the said engagement.
011: Chairperson's Message
012: It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to IPMX — the International Program in Management for Executives — our One-Year MBA at the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow. This program was built for executives like you: accomplished, driven, and ready for what comes next.
013: IPMX is anchored by rigorous academic training and a strong international immersion component, giving you both the depth and the global exposure this stage of your career demands. You will learn from faculty who are as respected for their scholarship as for their grasp of what actually works in the boardroom, and you will do so alongside peers and international partners who broaden how you see business and the world.
014: The program runs out of our dedicated campus in Noida, purpose-built to give the cohort a focused, immersive learning environment away from the everyday distractions of work. And the response from industry has been outstanding — recruiters consistently value the sharpness and readiness that IPMX graduates bring to the table.
015: What makes this journey special, though, is the community you will join — a close-knit group of ambitious leaders who push each other to think bigger, lead better, and grow together
016: I look forward to welcoming you to IPMX, and to being part of your journey ahead.
017: Prof. Chandan Sharma Professor and Chairperson, IPMX IIM Lucknow

In case the institution/university does not have any conversion formula for converting the CGPA into equivalent marks, the equivalence would be established by IIML by dividing the obtained CGPA by the maximum possible CGPA and multiplying the resultant by 100.
126: A minimum of 4 years full-time (Regular) post-qualification (after graduation) work experience as on 31st March 2027. The Programme is open to executives of all nationalities.
129: Candidate fills and submit the application form online Application Form andupload the scanned copies of the documents in support of the attainments mentioned in Eligibility Criteria;
170: Candidates who apply in IPMX Phase-I and are shortlisted for the WAT and PI but are not selected after the PI process will not be eligible to apply in IPMX Phase-II or Phase-III. Similarly, candidates who apply in IPMX Phase-I or Phase-II and are shortlisted for the WAT and PI but are not selected after the PI process will not be eligible to apply in IPMX Phase-III.
181: This is a 2-3 weeks' international module which will be conducted at one of our partner schools located in Europe/East Asia. This module aims to enhance cross-cultural experience and broaden understanding of global management challenges. Students would take courses and attend short duration workshops. They would also have the opportunity to interact with industry leaders and visit few industries.
187: Candidates may apply in subsequent phases, subject to the eligibility conditions applicable to their previous phase. However, if a candidate applies in Phase I or Phase II, is shortlisted for the WAT and PI, but is not selected after the PI process, the candidate will not be eligible to apply in the subsequent phase, i.e., Phase II or Phase III, respectively.
189: If a candidate applies in Phase I or Phase II but is not shortlisted for the WAT and PI, the candidate may apply in the subsequent phase, i.e., Phase II or Phase III, respectively, with an improved GMAT/GRE score, subject to the applicable eligibility criteria and the relevant application deadline.
191: If a candidate applies in Phase I or Phase II but does not appear for the WAT and PI, the candidate may apply in the subsequent phase, i.e., Phase II or Phase III, respectively, subject to the applicable eligibility criteria and the relevant application deadline.
193: Please ensure that all data such as your Date of Birth, academic qualifications (degree titles, duration names of the institution/university, grades/marks, GMAT/GRE scores etc.) and work experience are correctly entered. Please remember that all the details mentioned in the online application form will have to be supported by relevant documents later. The admission (if offered) will automatically stand cancelled if the data you enter and the data on the documents are found to be different.
200: Combined scanned PDF of all Graduation Marks Sheets and Degree.
201: Combined scanned PDF of all Post Graduation Marks Sheets and Degree.
203: Do undergraduate internships count towards the minimum work experience requirement?
204: No; all work experience must be post-graduation.
213: I would not like to disclose my intention of applying for a full time course to my immediate line manager. Who else can be my recommender?
221: What is the minimum acceptable GMAT/GRE score?
222: We do not specify a minimum GMAT/GRE score. The GMAT/GRE score is one of the criteria for evaluating a candidate. Some other criteria of evaluation include personal interview, professional experience, and leadership role, among many others.
237: The selection process and eligibility criteria are mentioned under ADMISSION tab on IPMX page of IIM Lucknow website.
238: Can one apply with graduation undertaken through a 2-year course?
239: No. The participants are required to have a minimum of 3 years of under-graduate study after 12 years of school education and the graduation should be from a recognized university or equivalent.
248: Will all applicants who fulfill the eligibility criteria be called for the interview?
249: No. A minimum cut-off score of GMAT/ GRE will be decided. Candidates will be called for WAT and PI based on that minimum cut-off score.
321: With a decade of professional work experience, I quickly realized that to make sense of business, I needed a Master's degree and IIM's were the natural choice. After much due diligence, I opted for IPMX, the full time one-year MBA program from IIM Lucknow. A tier 1 college, IIM Lucknow's differentiating factors are its wide alumni base, excellent industry connects, and its top-notch faculty from the Operations, Finance, Strategy, Behavioral, and Marketing domain. The much relevant pedagogy of IPMX gave me the required skillsets to make myself relevant and ready for the next phase in my professional career. IPMX is a definite enabler that really gears oneself for the next level of responsibilities in the corporate world.To summarize, the decision to take a career break and spend one full year at IIM Lucknow pursuing the IPMX program was the best one I have made and would highly recommend aspirational and passionate leaders of tomorrow to go for it.
323: After acquiring professional experience in IT and entry level management, I knew I needed a platform to hone my management skills and business acumen, and IPMX program provided me just that. The program is known not just for its academic rigor and case study based curricula, but also for the exposure it provides through a wide range of real business problems and holistic personal development that comes with learning from diverse group of intellects. Regular interactions with industry experts and industry visits helps one reset their perceptions and build perspectives. Change is the only constant in life, and I would attribute this program to the transformational change I was able to bring in myself.
327: I joined IPMX after more than 6 years of work experience. Unlike my previous learning experiences in school and graduation, IPMX was more focused on experiential learning. Its case study based learning, periodic quizzes, project activities, international module, experienced professors, guest lectures by industry stalwarts makes the course more interesting & challenging. In a nut shell, the learnings in IPMX have provided me with a structured problem solving approach which has helped me in every situation in my professional life. With IPMX's inter disciplinary learnings, I was able to make a successful career in Analytics consulting.
339: The International Programme in Management for Executives (IPMX) is the flagship programme of IIM Lucknow in NOIDA Campus. This one-year, full time residential programme with an intensive curriculum and a global outlook prepares the participants for leadership roles in Indian and international business environments. The rigor can be judged from the fact that the institute attract students with excellent GMAT score having minimum 5 years of experience in mid /sr. level management.

wait
printf '"'DIR=%s\\n' \""'$EXEC_TMP"; ls -lh "$EXEC_TMP"/*.html 2>/dev/null || true
python3 - "$EXEC_TMP" <<'"'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re
for p in sorted(Path(sys.argv[1]).glob('*.html')):
 s=BeautifulSoup(p.read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 print('\\n===',p.name,'TITLE=',s.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if s.title else '','===')
 for t in s(['script','style','noscript']): t.decompose()
 for a in s.find_all('a',href=True):

 text=' '.join(s.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
 print('TEXT',text[-5000:])
PY"

on LinkedIn Executive Education Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is an academic prowess platform which prospects, prepares, and prospers every aspirant who is looking forward to seek professional education in various digital and managerial sectors. The Executive Education Programmes at IIM Lucknow campus are extensively arrayed to offer a high-class technological, professional and inclusive experience to all the working executives that, come from various nuances of different organisations. Incorporating technological advancements like e-learning, e-books and real-time navigation is the new mandate in executive education nowadays. The diverse programme design and consistent practice to refurbish the teaching style every academic year at IIM Lucknow, makes it unique and demanding amongst all the new age and traditional company setups. Every executive education programme offered by IIM Lucknow is crafted in a manner that addresses the needs of schedule, strategy and implementation process of every organisation. Programmes are aligned to required skills and competency frameworks envisioned by learners. To conquer the ongoing business challenges, IIM Lucknow provides the novelty of programmes that are planned and provided accordingly every year. The Executive Education platform is intended to widen the outlook and reinforce the managerial, professional and technological skills of working professionals all over the world. The global visualisation of IIM Lucknow is to impart world-class executive education to all the working professionals in different domains and provide them a tactical tool to uplift their professional personas. Customized Programmes IIM Lucknow offers customized Executive Education programmes for corporate and government officials, that helps to elevate skills and overcome the day to day challenges of digital world. The Customized Programmes are tailored for group of working executives drawn from a single organisation or a consortium. Lasting impact and ingrained work culture are the imperative as well as desired necessity of every organisation, and to full fill the same, IIM Lucknow curates and delivers a number of customised programmes, that are eventually crafted by estimating the organisational needs, that cover every aspect of a company. Shaping impactful strategies into viable growth is the mission of IIM Lucknow, when it comes to offering a customized executive education programme. Developing a comprehensive customised programme requires the expertise of the faculties and proficient programme directors who take part in the designing process of a programme. The aim is to set up a compatibility between the programme designed and the organisational prerequisites, that are required to be fulfilled. This is further augmented by the inclusion of Subject Matter experts and Industry practitioners with who IIM Lucknow Faculty constantly engage on matters of upskilling and update. Innovative learning techniques and a interactive Pedagogy is offered to every of organisation that enrols for a customised programme at IIM Lucknow. For more information, feel free to email us at mdp[at]iiml[dot]ac[dot]in Contact us: 0522-6696283/82, Mobile no: 9599642800/6307476770 Register your Interest IIM Lucknow cascades an ample way to impart knowledge to working professionals and executives who are willing to upscale their knowledge to a higher level. Learn, Unlearn & Relearn is the prime pedagogy offered to every individual associated with the executive education programme with IIM Lucknow. Online Online is one such category of programmes that provides anywhere learning, that helps aspirants to join their online classes from any part of the world. Online learning programme is like an ease to executive education platform that, brings a newness to the teaching practice in the whole executive education vertical. Online programmes by IIML are an effort to combine classroom and online learning, which can be accessed by the executives at the ease of their flexibility, and proffer new heights to their careers. === menu9 ===
“If I die in combat zone Box me up and send me home Pin my medals to my chest Tell my mom I did my best” Anonymous : Popular lyric during training Introduction An exemplary setup to prove the highest standards of discipline, professionalism and dedication of service to the nation is what makes a framework of the officers in the Indian Armed Forces. Discipline, time management, nationalism and patriotism are ingrained in the very culture of their lives. Post-retirement the officers need to remodel their skills and attitude for a second career after serving in the Indian Armed Forces. The resolute spirit of selflessness, honesty and courage makes every Indian proud of the Indian armed forces. To keep this legacy framed forever, IIM Lucknow offers defence general management programmes for officers of the Indian Armed Forces almost every year that helps intensively to match the discipline of the Indian Army with the trends of the digital and managerial world. A combined initiative by the Directorate General Resettlement, Ministry of Defence and Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML), a six-month General Management Programme (GMP) for the Defence Officers is conducted at the Institute. Read More Objective The objective of the programme is to facilitate smooth second career transition of the Defence Officers into the corporate world and familiarize them towards contemporary and emerging global management practices. Duration The GMP for Defence Officers at IIML (Lucknow or NOIDA campus) is spread over duration of 24 weeks and comprises five terms. Third term completion follows with a one week break. Curriculum The curriculum consists of 5 modules. In each module there are seven subjects offered. There are core courses in each of the first three modules and elective subjects are offered in module 4 and module 5. The elective courses would be launched during the 4 th and 5 th module. This unique combination of compulsory and elective subjects, train them to develop a broad understanding of the subject matter and the issues central and critical to the success of business. Faculty Faculty from Indian Institute of Management Lucknow would deliver the program. Pedagogy A judicious mix of the following: Case method of learning Lectures Exercises , Assignments Group Projects & Presentations Peer Discussions Role Plays Evaluation and Certification The evaluation of academic performance is based on varying combinations of the following components: Assignments, Quizzes, Class participation etc. Project work End-term examination The Certificate will be awarded to such participants who in the judgment of the faculty have fulfilled all conditions and requirements for the same after the successful completion of all the five terms as per IIM Lucknow evaluation guidelines. 27th General Management Programme (24 weeks) for Defence Officers is scheduled from May 01 to Oct. 13, 2023 at the Lucknow campus. International Programme IIM Lucknow extends its educational wings internationally and covers the corporate based outside the country. The programmes are designed and delivered by the faculty of IIM Lucknow itself. The mission and vision of International programmes by IIML is to offer world-class education in every corner of the globe and prove its academic prowess in executive education sector globally. To gain an inclusive perspective on business, IIML consistently thrives in its international programme designs and keeps on revamping the syllabus according to the international province, where the programme is being offered.

=== menu2 ===
IIM Lucknow cascades an ample way to impart knowledge to working professionals and executives who are willing to upscale their knowledge to a higher level. Learn, Unlearn & Relearn is the prime pedagogy offered to every individual associated with the executive education programme with IIM Lucknow. Online Online is one such category of programmes that provides anywhere learning, that helps aspirants to join their online classes from any part of the world. Online learning programme is like an ease to executive education platform that, brings a newness to the teaching practice in the whole executive education vertical. Online programmes by IIML are an effort to combine classroom and online learning, which can be accessed by the executives at the ease of their flexibility, and proffer new heights to their careers.
